material-volume-reporting.rationale: Frequently specified core reporting capability needed for collection analysis, planning, and point-in-time comparisons.

shelf-space-utilization-report.rationale: Explicitly required for operational/leadership periodic reviews and depends on multiple detailed report behaviors.

branch-capacity-interface.rationale: Consortium-wide capacity/utilization visibility with drilldown and export is core for managing collections and operations.

item-transfer-batch-utility.rationale: Batch transfer with preview/labels/undo, history, and role permissions is essential operational functionality.

in-transit-and-missing-damaged-reports.rationale: Time-thresholded, unified operational lists directly support frontline handling of missing/damaged/in-transit items.

purging-and-weeding-utility.rationale: Weeding/purging with safety (last-copy) and audit trail is a critical risk-control workflow.

deletions-audit-and-reports.rationale: Audit logging and compliance-grade reporting for deletions is required for governance and traceability.

patron-characteristics-and-demographics-.rationale: High stakeholder emphasis (most sources) and includes privacy-protecting anonymized aggregates for planning.

inactive-patrons-report.rationale: Operationally important targeting/outreach workflow with exports and exclusions, but may be phased behind core reporting/audit capabilities.

uncataloged-material-inventory.rationale: Important inventory/reporting for uncataloged materials, though less universally referenced than core reporting and auditing requirements.

transactions-history-and-aggregation.rationale: Key for analytics with retention and aggregates, but other circulation/counting/reporting features may mitigate early gaps.

detailed-transaction-counts.rationale: Granular circulation/hold counting is foundational to many other collection and operational reports.

predefined-and-board-reports.rationale: Expected executive operational capability that can be added with templates/recurrences after the underlying reporting framework exists.

report-writer-features.rationale: Interactive report/query building (fields, Boolean/regex, saving) is essential to make the reporting suite usable.

report-templates-and-permissions.rationale: Template management and fine-grained permissions are necessary to safely deploy reports across roles and groups.

report-scheduling-queue-and-priority.rationale: Background queued execution with queue visibility/cancellation and admin prioritization is required for reliable use at scale.

report-output-formats-and-delivery.rationale: Multiple delivery formats and email distribution are required for practical consumption and downstream workflows.

real-time-and-historical-reporting.rationale: Historical point-in-time reproducibility plus real-time ops reporting is explicitly required and supports many audit/report use cases.

marc-and-field-level-reporting.rationale: Field/MARC-level pulling and bibliographic handling are core to collection-development and weeding/analysis reports.

data-quality-reports.rationale: Important for catalog integrity and migration/QA, but may be deliverable after core reporting and audit functions.

financial-reporting-and-ledger.rationale: Auditable financial reporting and ledger application of payments is core accounting/compliance functionality.

audit-and-compliance.rationale: Legal/accounting/privacy constraints and configurable retention requirements are fundamental and explicitly mandated.

technical-environment-and-compatibility.rationale: Platform/browser/database constraints are essential constraints for deployment and correct operation.

non-disruptive-reporting-and-replicas.rationale: Queuing/background processing is required; replica-based offload is important but can be a phased enhancement.

development-and-training-environments.rationale: Separating environments and migration tooling is important for rollout safety but not as core as runtime reporting/audit.

role-based-access-and-authentication.rationale: RBAC, authentication, and audit-relevant logging are essential security requirements.

online-help-and-error-reporting.rationale: Documentation and diagnostics improve usability, but core system value can exist without it in the first release.

data-specifications-and-process-document.rationale: Required for interpretability and integration/report authoring, but some parts can be delivered as supporting artifacts later.

enterprise-integration-and-opac-interact.rationale: Interfaces with enterprise systems and non-interference with OPAC performance are explicit operational constraints.

ui-quick-access-and-tooltips.rationale: Improves discoverability and training burden, but can be deferred behind core reporting functionality.

null-and-blank-field-handling.rationale: Correct null/blank inclusion and documented filter behavior is explicitly required for report correctness and interpretability.

survey-name-filtering.rationale: Usability enhancement for survey-derived fields; beneficial but not strictly necessary for core reporting delivery.

export-and-excel-quality.rationale: Export compatibility and duplicate-row avoidance are important; can be staged after core reporting outputs exist.

snapshot-bills-and-last-circulation-repo.rationale: Snapshot/last-circulation support is valuable for auditing/weeding but less broadly referenced than core reporting primitives.

renewal-exclusion-in-checkin-timestamps.rationale: Prevents metric corruption (recency inflation) and is explicitly stated as a correctness requirement.

last-edit-date-visibility.rationale: Helpful metadata correctness for staff workflows, but may be omitted early while other recency indicators exist.

efficient-batch-update-safety.rationale: Batch update preview/undo/permissioning and efficient locking behavior are required for safe large-volume operations.

vendor-integration-apis.rationale: Important for acquisitions/processing automation and security, but some integration can be implemented incrementally.

support-large-consortium-scale.rationale: Explicit scalability requirements (large consortia, high-volume reporting/batches) constrain system design for acceptance.

report-selection-criteria-display.rationale: Displaying preserved selection criteria with results is explicitly required for auditability and reproducibility.

snapshot-bills-and-last-circulation.rationale: Default priority (not assigned by the model).
